question: Which of the following is a socio-economic Directive Principle?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Equal pay for equal work**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Equal pay for equal work** is a socio-economic Directive Principle enshrined in the **Indian Constitution**.
 
• It is provided under **Article 39(d)** of the Directive Principles of State Policy (DPSP).
